jobs.title: Sr IT Program Manager -SAP Modernization
jobs.description:
Requisition: 82832

PSEG Company: PSEG Services Corp.

Salary Range: $ 136,600 - $ 253,600

Work Location Category: Hybrid

We’re one of the country’s largest energy companies, with a vision of powering a future where people use energy more efficiently and it’s safer and delivered more reliably than ever.  We’re also deeply connected to the communities we serve, with more than 13,000 employees working together to support our customers and make a difference every day.
Here, you’ll have the stability and exciting opportunities that come with being a Fortune 500 company — along with a supportive, friendly work environment where your contributions are valued.

We offer a flexible work environment designed to balance employee needs with collaboration and operational excellence. Roles fall into two categories:
• Onsite: Employees work onsite daily.
• Hybrid: A blend of remote and onsite work, with at least three onsite days per week required.

As an employee, if you are regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week, you will have access to a wide range of comprehensive benefits from day one, designed to support your total well-being: medical, dental, vision, parental leave and family leave programs, behavioral health programs, 401(k) with company match, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, and generous paid time off.

More than 13,000 people already call PSEG their work home, taking pride in providing safe, reliable service to millions of customers. If you’re looking for a place where you can build a meaningful career and help power and support our communities, we’d love to welcome you to the team.

PSEG is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

Job Summary

The Sr. IT Program Manager is responsible for the management of multiple Project Managers, which are embedded with our Product Oriented Delivery Teams. The Sr Program Manager will be responsible for the SI scope management and ensuring the delivery of all milestones and deliverables outlined.  Additionally, they will oversee all aspects of assigned programs throughout project lifecycles to ensure completion within the defined scope, quality, and time and cost constraints. Supervises individual project managers. E nsures accurate allocations of resources throughout the program. Leads multi- disciplinary teams, composed of various levels of personnel, vendors, and clients to create and deploy successful programs. The Sr Program Manager will be responsible for working closely with our SAP PMO, SI and PMOQA Partners, as well as internal teams, ensure adherence to scope and the identification and mitigation of technical impediments. Programs may contain elements of work outside of the scope of the discrete projects in the program.
The main purpose of the role is to deliver strategic value of a business-aligned SAP Modernization Program through effective team and initiative management. The Sr. IT Program Manager works with peers to shape portfolio needs and ensure that the individual disciplines are aligned towards meeting the strategic goals of the SAP Modernization Project. The resource will use their proven experience managing complex programs to improve business experience, minimize technical debt, and ensure successful delivery of projects. Role will support business and IT leaders to plan, scope, and develop programs and projects to implement business-aligned IT strategies. Develops and manages internal resources to continuously deliver technology and process value within an IT Tower or product aligned portfolio.

Job Responsibilities

- Manage a team of Project Managers ensuring adherence to Project Deliverable, Milestones in accordance with PMO Stage Gate Processes and Governance Frameworks and SoWs.

- Lead and manage programs by coordinating activities and delivery across multiple, related projects or work streams that span technology and areas.

- Ensures program meets schedule and scope targets.

- Identify, develop mitigation plans, and monitor to drive timely and effective escalation and risk/issue resolution.

- Manage and/or escalate issues and/or complications and respond well to time pressures.

- Track dependencies and risks, and assessing change impact across interdependent work streams and projects.

- Capture all pertinent actions and decisions.

- Provide oversight and guidance to those managing smaller projects within specific business unit domain.

- Oversees project resources to deliver required project artifacts/goals.

- Use effective people engagement skills to drive contact with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle to manage expectations, establish timelines, and grow relationships.

- Ensure alignment on scope, value proposition and overall project goals.

- Work with functional departments to coordinate systems testing, deployment, training, and support.

- Track and communicate progress.

- Provide project status report updates to project stakeholders through project level and executive steering committees, maintaining an effective communication cadence.

- Ensure proper communication and change management processes are adopted for all major change initiatives.

- Work Closely with Analytics, OCM, QA, Cost, Scheduling and Program Leadership to accurately report on program status and health.

- Manage team and work to build core competencies within the area with a focus on operational excellence.

- Oversees vendor deliverables, ensures vendor adherence to contract terms, works with leadership on vendor performance and SLA compliance.

- Facilitate project tailoring and artifact development to align with project management processes in accordance with project sizing.

Job Specific Qualifications

- Bachelors degree and 8 years experience in leading large projects. In lieu of a degree, 10 years of experience in leading large projects.

- Understanding of and experience with IT project management methodologies, requirements management, quality assurance and IT processes from project inception to successful implementation

- Understanding of financial principles including experience with project financial budgeting and planning.

- Strong communication, organization, and facilitation skills. Effective presentation skills and the ability to articulate complex concepts to cross functional audiences.

- Experience managing outsourced vendors (on and off shore).

- Strong judgment and analytical ability.

- Leadership, teamwork and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to foster working relationships with the team, IT Management and functional departments.

- Experience in supervising/managing program team members or direct reports as part of program execution.

- Department of Energy’s regulation 10 CFR 810 is required

Desired

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

- Masters Business Administration

- Demonstrated Experience with Primavera P6

- Demonstrated Experience with Project Tracking tools such as JIRA

- Experience on large scale transformational technology projects

Some positions at PSEG require access to information covered by the Department of Energy’s regulation 10 CFR 810 (Part 810). If applicable, the successful applicant must prove they are: (1) a citizen or national of the USA; OR (2) a lawful permanent resident of the United States (Non-Conditional Permanent I-551 / Green Card / Permanent Resident Card holder); OR (3) a citizen, national, or permanent resident of a “Generally Authorized” destination on the  attached list not also a citizen, national, permanent resident of any country not listed; OR (4) a “Protected Individual” under the Immigration and Naturalization Act (8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3)).

As an employee of PSEG, you should be aware that during emergency restoration efforts, you may be required to perform functions outside of your routine duties and on a schedule that may be different from normal operations.
For all roles, PSEG’s drug and alcohol testing program includes pre-employment testing, testing for cause, and post-incident/accident testing.
Employees who are hired or transfer into a federally regulated role (including positions covered by USDOT, PHMSA, or NRC regulations) are subject to random drug and alcohol testing, inclusive of marijuana. Although numerous states throughout the country have legalized marijuana/cannabis products recreationally and medically, the use of these products are prohibited for employees in federally regulated roles. Please note that the use of CBD products may result in a positive drug test for THC/Marijuana and such use is not a legitimate medical explanation for a positive result.

Job Summary

At this time, only current PSEG employees are being considered

This is a highly visible role within PSEG’s centralized performance improvement organization with the opportunity to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that improve how work gets done across the company. The Project Leader partners with business leaders to redesign end-to-end value streams, solve persistent performance challenges, and translate improvement opportunities into sustainable changes in process, business and technology architecture, data, roles, and accountability.. The role also helps connect process improvement with the broader evolution of business capabilities, technology, data and operating models. Project initiatives include cost management, performance efficiency, process development, ownership/alignment, and other operational initiatives, in addition to including large-scale transformational projects focused on supporting the company’s core business results.

Job Responsibilities

- Delivers business and value stream solutions that will enable the company to maintain its high performance, business leadership position in Operational Excellence, Financial Strength, and Disciplined Investment.

- Independently leads business leaders and complex cross functional teams from problem identification through future-state design and implementation, using approaches such as. DMAIC, ADKAR, PDCA, value-stream mapping, Kaizen events and root cause analysis as appropriate. Independently drives sessions (e.g. meetings, workshops) for project chartering, ideal state brainstorming, current state process mapping, root cause analysis, solution brainstorming, future state process control system mapping and development, implementation planning and 30-60-90 implementation tracking. Project manages and/or coaches trained business resources through Value Stream Mapping, Kaizen Events, Lean Six Sigma projects, Root Cause Analysis, and Change Management efforts.

Job Specific Qualifications

- Undergraduate degree in engineering, business administration or other analytical field.

- 7 years of demonstrated experience in process development, performance efficiency, continuous improvement or equivalent experience.

- Demonstrated ability to challenge established ways of working constructively, influence leaders without direct authority, and create momentum for change across organizational boundaries.

- Working knowledge of value stream management and value streams.

- Technical mastery of Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt Certification) or other process improvement methodologies.

- Working knowledge of value stream management and value streams.

- Project management skills and ability to work multiple projects simultaneously.

- Experience in driving change management.

- Strong training, presentation, and communication skills - both written and oral. Strong understanding of analytical tools and statistics.

- Ability to lead, and coach facilitators.

- Strong leadership and interpersonal skills; ability to work cross-functionally on sensitive issues. Ability to execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

- Ability to foster an inclusive work environment and respect all aspects of diversity.

- Prior experience with process documentation.

- Department of Energy’s regulation 10 CFR 810 is required.

Desired

- Six sigma black belt certified and experience with both the delivery and deployment of business transformation projects.

- PMI Certification

- Experience using business architectural frameworks, defining business capabilities, and collaborating across IT and business teams to ensure process, technology, and data alignment is strongly preferred.

Job Summary

At this time, only current PSEG employees are being considered.

This role will lead the strategy, redesign, and execution of myPSEGconnect and support employee experience and engagement programs, including employee listening, recognition and other engagement initiatives.

The role is responsible for building and executing a comprehensive strategy for myPSEGconnect to improve the site and user experience aligned with the company’s employee experience and engagement objectives; specifically, driving integration between employee experience and engagement strategy and digital touchpoints.  The role will also leverage AI-enabled functionality to enhance self-service access, personalization, and workforce productivity and support workforce optimization in related initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

- Lead development and execution of a comprehensive strategy to modernize myPSEGconnect; define the vision, roadmap, governance model, content architecture, and success metrics aligned to employee experience strategy.  Ensure the website serves as a primary channel to reinforce engagement initiatives and enterprise culture.

- Partner with HR Centers of Excellence and IT to redesign site structure, improve usability, and ensure accurate, accessible, and intuitive employee-facing content.

- Leverage AI-enabled website functionality (e.g., chatbots, intelligent search, personalization tools) to enhance employee self-service, streamline access to HR platforms, and improve user experience.

- Establish performance metrics and analytics to measure website adoption, engagement, and employee satisfaction; continuously optimize based on data insights.

- Support enterprise employee listening and recognition programs, including survey and listening activities, recognition initiatives, communications, and program execution. Partner with HR and business stakeholders to translate employee feedback and program insights into actions that strengthen the employee experience and engagement.

- Support additional employee experience and engagement initiatives, including enterprise events and other programs that strengthen the employee experience.

- As an employee of PSE&G, during storm/outage restoration efforts, may be required to perform functions different from normal operations and the regular work schedule. May also be required to work in an alternate location.

Job Specific Qualifications

- BA/BS with 5 years relevant experience; 8 years in lieu of degree

- Strong project management skills, including experience leading cross-functional projects, managing stakeholders, and delivering measurable outcomes

- Demonstrated ability to create and curate digital content

- Familiarity with workplace culture initiatives and related change management
